Author: amarinne
Name: Auto-Marketbuddy
Punchline: Preview and undercut retainer listings with a clear stop control.
Description: Preview or set existing retainer listing prices to the undercut target using fresh in-game comparisons. No companion plugin required.
Changelog: * v1.1.0: API 15 rewrite. Native market comparisons, preview/apply with explicit confirmation, guarded slot targeting, Stop, five-minute comparison cache, optional sale-history fallback.
